station.name: Voice of Peace
station.editorial_disclosure: News reports are based on information attributed to reliable sources. Voice of Peace reflections are editorial commentary.

stories.headline: Man taken into custody after reported unprovoked street assault
stories.summary: In this fictional demonstration story, police say Brian Smith, a man in his 60s, was taken into custody after allegedly striking Matthew Schoenfeld, a man in his 20s, near 42nd Street and Lexington Avenue in Manhattan. This sample is included only to demonstrate the broadcast format and is not a real news report.
stories.source_line: DEMO STORY — fictional example for app testing. Real stories will list their actual sources here.

reflection.message: Hurting a stranger for attention, entertainment, or online popularity is the opposite of the world we should build. A million views do not turn cruelty into success; they only give a harmful act a larger audience. Strength means protecting people, controlling anger, and choosing kindness over humiliation.

stories.ticker: Choose kindness • Protect one another • Do not chase fame by hurting people • Peace begins with us

stories.headline: Voice of Peace principle: disagreement does not require hatred
stories.summary: This demonstration segment shows how the channel can handle conflict stories: report verified facts first, then clearly separate the station's peace-centered editorial reflection.
stories.source_line: DEMO FORMAT — connect licensed or permitted news feeds before publishing real-world reports.

reflection.message: People and nations can disagree strongly without dehumanizing one another. Peace is not weakness. It requires courage, restraint, truth, and the willingness to recognize the humanity of people on the other side.

stories.ticker: Seek peace and pursue it • Truth before rumors • Humanity before hatred

stories.headline: Helping a neighbor can be news too
stories.summary: Voice of Peace will not focus only on violence and crisis. The network can also surface acts of generosity, rescue, honesty, reconciliation, and people helping strangers.
stories.source_line: DEMO FORMAT — positive-news and community sources can be added to the automated feed.

reflection.verse_text: The world is built on kindness
reflection.message: News should remind us that goodness is happening every day. When somebody helps another person without expecting a reward, that action deserves attention too. What we celebrate influences what society learns to value.

stories.ticker: Make kindness contagious • Help someone today • Celebrate people who do good

stories.headline: Truth matters before a story goes viral
stories.summary: The Voice of Peace engine is designed to distinguish verified reporting from rumor and to show source attribution before adding any editorial message.
stories.source_line: DEMO FORMAT — production version should verify important claims across multiple reputable sources.

reflection.verse_text: Distance yourself from a false matter
reflection.message: Sharing an exciting rumor can feel harmless, but false information can damage real people. Before repeating a claim, slow down, verify it, and ask whether you are spreading truth or merely spreading attention.

stories.ticker: Truth first • Verify before sharing • Do not turn rumors into weapons
